messages.ko: 오늘로 서울에서 콘서트는 끝이 났네ㅔ ㅜㅜ
messages.en: With today, the concerts in Seoul have ended. ㅜㅜ

messages.ko: 저번투어 콘서트했던게 엊그제같은데 벌써 알피콘도 끝이라니! 그래도 다음 콘도 눈 깜빡하면 다가오겠지?? 이번 콘서트 못온사람두 못왔다고 너무 속상해하지 말고! 타이페이 콘서트도 아직 남았으니까 아직 알피는끝나지 않았어 ㅎㅎ 항상 느끼는거지만 정말 부족한 나지만 보러 와주고 응원해줘서 고마워 ㅠ
messages.en: It feels like yesterday that we had the last tour concerts, but the Alpha concerts are already over! Still, if you blink, the next concert will come, right?? For those who couldn’t come to this concert, don’t be too upset. The Taipei concert is still left, so Alpha isn’t over yet. ㅎㅎ Even though I always feel this way, though I’m still lacking, thank you for coming to see me and for cheering for me. ㅠ

messages.ko: 콘서트할때마다 마지막쯤엔 공연소감을 말하는데 그앞에선 깊은 내 진심을 다 말하기엔 너무 길어서 항상 끝나고 프롬으로 얘기하는것같은데 직접 말 못해줘서 항상 아쉽고 더 길게 말할걸 더 표현할걸 후회하기도 해 이번 서울콘서트에선 나의 자잘한 실수도 많았고 개인적으로 완벽하지 못한 무대들이였다고 생각해.. 몸 컨디션도 제대로 못챙겼고 그런 부분에서 정말 미안해ㅜㅜ 콘서트 보러와서 이런모습 보고싶었던건 아닐텐데 너무 속상하고 더 잘할수 있었는데 하는 나에게 서운함도 있어 근데 콘서트는 무대에 서는 아티스트나 응원해주러온 팬분들이나 즐겁고 행복하자고 하는거니까 앞으로 더 나아진 모습을 약속하고!! 지금은 행복만 남겨둘게 웨이브앞에선 항상 잘하고 멋지고 이쁜 모습만 보여주고싶은 욕심이 너무커서 오히려 속상함도 큰것같아 하지만 그래서 내가 성장할수 있는것같다고 느꼈어! 이제 활동도 있고 이것저것 또 만날수 있는 날들이 엄청 많을텐데 지금처럼 옆에서 응원해주면 난 뭐든 할수있을것같아☺️ 나한텐 팬 한명한명이 다 소중하고 많이 사랑해 나를 좋아하는게 물론 당연하지 않은것도 알고 조건없이 날 사랑해주는 사람들한테 정말 잘하고싶어!! 오늘 와준 웨이브 너무너무 고맙고 못온 웨이브도 응원해줘서 고마워 ㅎㅎ 오래 많이 행복하게 보자! 나의 힘이 되어줘서 고마워 나도 항상 힘이 되어줄게ㅔ😘 오글거려도 참아 내 진심이니까~
messages.en: Every time we have a concert, I share my thoughts near the end, but saying all of my true feelings there would take too long, so I always end up talking about them on Fromm afterwards. I'm always disappointed that I can't say everything directly, and I often regret not expressing myself more. At this Seoul concert, I made quite a few small mistakes, and personally I don't think my performances were perfect. I also didn't take good care of my physical condition, and I'm really sorry about that. ㅜㅜ You probably didn't come to see this kind of 모습 from me, and I feel so upset because I know I could have done better. But concerts are meant to be a happy and enjoyable time for both the artists on stage and the fans who come to cheer us on, so I promise I'll continue to improve. For now, I'll leave behind only the happy memories. My desire to always show WAVs only my best, coolest, and prettiest side is so strong that I think that's why I get even more disappointed. But because of that, I also feel like I can continue to grow. We have promotions coming up, and there will be so many more opportunities for us to meet. If you continue cheering me on by my side like you do now, I feel like I can do anything. ☺️ Every single fan is precious to me, and I love you all so much. I know that liking me isn't something I should ever take for granted, and I truly want to do my best for the people who love me unconditionally. Thank you so, so much to the WAVs who came today, and thank you to the WAVs who couldn't come but still supported me. ㅎㅎ Let's stay together happily for a very, very long time! Thank you for becoming my strength. I'll always become your strength too. 😘 Even if it's cheesy, please endure it, because these are my sincere feelings~
And also, yesterday's failed Vampire Hayeon.
Up until that moment, I thought I'd actually be able to wear them.
For example... a dream about Hayeon?
